source: Identified-model table: physics (MuJoCo biped, frozen gait dr-default-s0) vs the NavGym v2/v4 randomization box,

rows.q: steady-state gain at |u|=1 (walking 0.15-0.35 m/s)
steady-state gain at |u|=1 (in place)
gain at |u|=0.6 (all speeds)
gain at |u|=0.3 walking (concave input map)
rows.verdict: outside (above at 0.15 m/s; gym is linear)

rows.q: gain at |u|=0.3 in place (dead zone)
first-order tau, continuous FOPDT on the integrated step (s)
rows.gym_note: gym fitted by the same procedure

dead time (s), continuous fit
FIR step response after 1 / 2 policy steps (PRBS p=0.02-0.7)
max rate at the interface limit |u|=1 (rad/s)

rows.q: bang-bang square wave +-1 at 0.35 m/s: gain of the fundamental 0.5/1.5/3/6.25 Hz, every-step flip (12.5 Hz)
rows.gym_note: slow corner (1.17, 0.45 s, 2 steps) and fast corner (1.17, 0.15 s, 0 steps)

rows.q: square-wave phase lag at 0.5/1.5/3/6.25 Hz (deg)
mean of a +-1 chatter while walking (0.3 m/s): realized rate for duty-cycle mean m=0.33/0.5/0.75, iid chatter
in place: realized rate for const / fastest-PWM / iid chatter of mean 0.33, 0.5, 0.75
rows.verdict: outside (dead zone; PWM of mean <= 0.5 does not turn)

per-step heading change under the actors' own chatter (deg, median / p90)
stride wobble: yaw-rate RMS (rad/s) / heading p-p (deg) / freq (Hz) at 0.35 m/s

steady-state gain at 0.15 / 0.25 / 0.35 m/s

start from standstill at 0.15 m/s
stop tau (s) from 0.25-0.35 m/s

rows.q: dead time (s)
max speed at v_cmd = V_MAX (m/s)
speed ratio during a constant turn at 0.35 m/s, |u|=1 / |u|=1.5
speed ratio under +-1 chatter: PRBS p=0.5/0.7 (0.3 m/s) / 3 Hz square / the actors' own sequences

rows.q: lateral sway: lateral-speed RMS (m/s) at 0.35 m/s
team_sensors speed brake: v *= clip((clear - 0.42)/0.48, 0, 1), +-25 deg forward cone, 10 Hz packets (+ depth term)

rows.q: lidar/map pipeline: 10 Hz packets held 2-3 steps; biped --policy path integrates each packet at the NEXT step's pose
rows.phys: maze_explore.py run_seed (biped branch, learned['emap'].update at the loop top)
rows.gym: fresh scan each step at the current pose
